This matches the GB, DE and ES sibling findings on the identical shared taxonomy node (seoId 1170) -- 4-for-4 on this platform. No separate Outlet/Liquidation/Soldes-permanentes/Fin-de-serie/Destockage URL exists anywhere in nav, sitemap, or robots.txt. Concluding no genuine Clearance PLP exists on Zara Home FR.
